source: HAND bathtub (GEM-15 (experimental, model-predicted) DTM 15 m area-averaged to 30 m, gaps from Copernicus GLO-30); ESA WorldCover 2021; WorldPop 2020; OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (ODbL)
method: Screening volumes 5, 20, 100 Mm³ (not tied to any reported event) on the static HAND volume→stage table of the whole corridor (flood/hand_lut.json). Wet = HAND < h. Cropland/built-up = WorldCover 2021 class 40/50 area fractions; buildings = building centroids (Microsoft ML footprints where available, else OSM); roads = OSM highway lines of all classes; villages = OSM place nodes whose lowest built cell within 300 m is below h, depth = h − HAND there. No timing: arrival_h is null (needs ANUGA).
uncertainty: Scenario exploration, not a forecast. 30 m terrain. Static bathtub: one water height along the whole corridor at once, no timing or attenuation. Exposure, not damage. OSM buildings and roads are incomplete (lower bounds); roads only partly downloaded (see hand_lut uncertainty). Volumes below 26.3 Mm³ (h < 0.5 m) are not meaningful.
